learner_operation: Decompose y=u^(+/-1/2), differentiate outer and inner, multiply and substitute; evaluate at target x for slopes, adding the observed cubic derivative when present.

fixed_features.feature: Square-root or reciprocal-square-root outer function and linear/quadratic inner polynomial
fixed_features.justification: All captured KP questions and e-182 use these operations.

fixed_features.feature: Positive square radicand at evaluated point
fixed_features.justification: Preserves real differentiability and source easy numeric arithmetic.

fixed_features.feature: Five radio options or a math blank
fixed_features.justification: Observed response contracts. No need to fix which position or scalar role is correct.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary target and coefficients within real differentiable domain, including legitimate zero slopes.
answer_roles.observed: Source/template coverage retained; same quadratic evaluated at 1,5,9 gives positive, zero, negative slopes.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary distractors and correct numeric rank without a value-shape cue identifying the answer.
answer_roles.observed: All five signed ranks exercised; irregular spacing repairs old cue, but nearest-zero remains predictive within linear-root slope template.

counterfactuals.expected: Slopes 4/3,0,-4/3 with matching substitutions, keys, rendered text and grading.
counterfactuals.observed: All matched. Native grader accepts independent equivalent entries and rejects shifted answers; screenshots inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: q-342792 and q-342789 assess evaluated chain-rule slopes; target assignment is incidental.

counterfactuals.change: Hold y=sqrt(9+4x), x=0, role=2; seeds 610 and 611 change distractors/order.
counterfactuals.expected: Preserve answer 2/3, prompt, solution and grader outcome.
counterfactuals.observed: Preserved; banks differ, both actual UI views and all radio grades checked.
counterfactuals.justification: Source radios assess derivative value, not distractor identity or display position.

delivery.result: All 5 actual batch, 47 initial samples, and 15 focused records survive. Nearest-zero bias survives (8/15 focused; 1/1 batch radio). Three formerly affected stored radios are retired; no eligible stored generated radio remains. Source radios are originals, not generated.

limitations: Nearest-zero shortcut is probabilistic (8/15 fresh), not claimed to solve every generated question.
No shortcut-free guarantee from finite samples; ancillary 5-case cue groups are descriptive.
Inventory basis 5663 only; future publications, entity IDs, policy weights and learner histories may change selection.
Unchanged source data and sampling rules verified against prior independent package; broad unchanged-domain evidence reused, not re-audited exhaustively.
